1086908960284df0ef429a41b4494d99a4c3d6a5.title: System boundaries
1086908960284df0ef429a41b4494d99a4c3d6a5.description: The installed product reads local media and uses application-owned caches. The website provides documentation independently of the installed product and its media files.

839423e927181e12077bd5f7d74d41df3b1a2c90.title: Gallery lifecycle
839423e927181e12077bd5f7d74d41df3b1a2c90.description: Opening a directory resolves its root and settings, then checks access. Discovery produces a gallery session; inaccessible directories produce an actionable error. Refresh updates the session, and closing releases its resources.

c0e0cecb316da2a8b39ec4d1a7384feeb1650ff8.title: Installation, verification and recovery
c0e0cecb316da2a8b39ec4d1a7384feeb1650ff8.description: Installation inspects ownership, versions and integration before selecting an explicit action. Staged changes are verified before commit; failures invoke recovery and rollback. Conflicts require resolution before any replacement.

9b81e0d684cb77fdc80946f151df926217bdc665.title: Optional thumbnail generation
9b81e0d684cb77fdc80946f151df926217bdc665.description: Optional thumbnail generation inspects existing artifacts and plans bounded work. Each output is validated before commit. Cancellation, stale inputs and failed validation discard unfinished outputs while preserving original media.
